about_the_game:
This is a collection of pixel art assets by pixel art artist Mokemo of 20 different types of battle monsters created from a variety of themes including ghosts, Self-Supporting Driven Tanks, sea creatures, dinosaurs, human beast and more. The unique monsters will bring thrills and adventures to your game world, providing players with surprises and excitement. When used in conjunction with Vol. 1, a deeper and more diverse world can be created.

[Mokemo Factory MONSTER PIXEL PACK Vol.2] Contents

2D Stamps: 20 types
Color Variations: 3 colors for each monster
Outline: None, black, and color
Image Size: 48x192 (4 animation patterns)
